title: Doctorado en Ciencia y Tecnología de Inteligencia Artificial y Ciencia de Datos
institution: Instituto Politécnico Nacional (IPN), Centro de Innovación y Desarrollo Tecnológico en Cómputo (CIDETEC)
about: IPN's doctorate in AI and data science, taught at five IPN sites including CIDETEC, has B27 (August 2027) applicant registration from 7 September 2026 to 16 April 2027. Selection uses GRE or EXANI-III, English level and an interview.
requirements: Aimed mainly at applicants with a master's degree in computing, engineering, exact sciences or related fields, particularly AI and data science
Selection criteria (B26 call) include a GRE or EXANI-III score, English proficiency, a personal interview with the admission committee and the CV
Programme offered at five IPN sites: CIC, CIDETEC, ESCOM, ESFM and UPIITA

upskill.name: Machine Learning - Foundations & Methods I
why: Field "Artificial intelligence and data science" → objective "Supervised learning: classification, regression, decision trees, SVMs, ensemble methods"

Requirement "master's degree in computing, engineering, exact sciences or related fields, particularly AI and data science" → objective "Unsupervised learning: clustering (k-means, DBSCAN), dimensionality reduction (PCA, t-SNE, UMAP)"
Skill "Data science" → objective "Semi-supervised and self-supervised learning: leveraging unlabelled data at scale"
